package.name: @aro/eastasianwidth-compat

generatorAdaptation.reason: Portable output directory in a copied new generator only; never edit original candidate or old implementation

integrationQueue.action: In a new owned image build, replace the entire eastasianwidth module directory wherever npm/Gemini/cache resolutions find it with this distinct private package. Preserve npm/Node/Bun versions and all Auth/API choices; retain original inventory warning objects and old/new hashes separately.
integrationQueue.pass: Final image and actual npm/module entry resolve new index/ranges/data/notices; no old implementation bytes anywhere in delivered runtime trees; npm behavior and original native hashes unchanged

integrationQueue.action: Transform/remove old eastasianwidth in every delivered source tree before archiving, including Node22 deps/npm/node_modules/eastasianwidth and npm sources. Do not deliver unchanged original eastasianwidth source/published tarballs or unchanged Node/npm upstream archives that contain it. Preserve originals only as private historical evidence. Include this new package, full Unicode6.0 preferred data/headers, generator and both actual notices. Record input/output archive hashes, paths and replacement hashes. Never distribute a unified diff containing the deleted old body.
integrationQueue.pass: Enumerated final archive members and extracted payload hashes prove absence of old implementation and presence of new source/data/notices; no original archive with old code in release allowlist; portable new generator reproduces ranges
integrationQueue.gate: Final source-archive validator and image integration are parent-owned next-graph work, not material acceptance
